description: WCH CH340N — USB 2.0 full-speed to UART bridge, SOP-8 package, internal clock (no external crystal needed). 5 V or 3.3 V operation. The simplest possible USB-serial bridge for MCUs without native USB — drop-in cheaper and smaller than CH340G.
name: ch340n
watch_out_for: Requires Windows / Linux / macOS driver (WCH publishes one). TX/RX are 5 V or 3.3 V depending on VIO; tie VIO to the MCU rail to match logic levels. No DTR/RTS auto-reset circuit built in — for Arduino-style auto-reset, add the typical 100 nF + diode reset network.
